'''Grophets''',<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grophet}}</ref> were an [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of quadrupeds native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] that were known for their stubbornness and intelligence. Because of their dislike of pens and cages, grophet were highly difficult to domesticate. These creatures used their sensitive hearing, body mass, and nodule-packed foreheads to protect themselves from predators. The grophet were highly sought after by game hunters, as the animals' entrails were considered a delicacy among the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="codex" />

Gophets' young were called "Grophlets".<ref name="Geothermal">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Geothermal Disruption]]|[[Dantooine]]}}</ref>

Several Grophlets were present on board of [[Jannimak]] and survived its [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> inhabiting a region designated by [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] as [[Geothermal Disruption]].<ref name="Geothermal" />
